# @axiomify/cache

> 标签: axiomify, cache, cache-control, caching, etag, redis, stale-while-revalidate

## 简介

Response caching for Axiomify — ETag/conditional GET for dynamic responses, Cache-Control helpers, pluggable memory/Redis stores, stale-while-revalidate.

- 官网：https://github.com/OTopman/axiomify/blob/main/docs/packages/cache.md
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/OTopman/axiomify.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@axiomify/cache
